text:
Lia: Heads up — partner asked for a retainer + consumption credit structure for SI-led marketplace deals. They want predictable cash for Q3 and a path to convert some unused credits into renewal discounts. Need alignment on discount bands, conversion rules, and joint announcement timing.

Mike: Quick context — their ask: $200k upfront retainer -> $250k consumption credits over 12 months + $20k co-marketing fund. They want an option to convert up to part of unused credits into renewal credit.

Jordan: PS/ops flag — we need SKU-level mapping for credits (hosted token vs dedicated hours). If we don't map precisely billing/reporting will be a mess.

Amy: Legal thumbs up to the idea but we'll need audit rights & clawback language if usage is artificially low at renewal. Also non-transferability clause.

Sam: RevOps — note on ARR recognition: upfront retainer vs consumption credits converts revenue recognition. I'll run scenarios for conversion-to-renewal impacts.

Lia: Proposed guardrails: 1) credits valid 12 months from invoice; 2) up to 30% of unused credits convertible to renewal discount with 60-day notice; 3) co-marketing funds released on milestones. Thoughts?

Mike: Pricing suggestion: treat retainer as discounted prepay. Example offer: $200k retainer = list $230k usage value, partner effective discount ~13%. Also propose a small co-marketing uplift (5-10%) for joint announce. Example SKU mapping below: 

```
# SKU mapping (proposal)
sku.retainer.basic = Retainer_Credits_12m
sku.credit.token = HOSTED_TOKEN_USD
sku.dedicated.hour = DEDICATED_GPU_HOUR
```

Jordan: Ops asks — need an offer flag `convertible_credits=true`, automated expiry, and an audit log for conversions. Prefer to own the SKU mapping in the billing system.

DevBot: Automation note — draft template `retainer_credit_v1` created in Notion: https://notion.so/retainer_credit_v1 and a follow-up reminder scheduled.

Amy: Legal redlines to expect: add 90-day audit window post-term, cap on conversion % explicitly, require SI signature, and no resale of credits. I'll drop a redline doc.

Lia: Marketing/comms ask — partner wants joint press. Can we commit to a 30-day co-announce window after customer go-live (not after contract signature)?

Mike: If co-announce misses timeline, propose partner gets an extra 5% credit on next renewal as make-good. Keeps incentives aligned.

Sam: I'll model cashflow + ARR effects and share a matrix (best/worst case) by EOD Wed.

Lia: Next steps: Jordan to spec SKU mapping + ops changes; Amy to send legal redline; Mike to negotiate with partner on conversion %, marketing funds, and make-good; Sam to model ARR/cashflow. Ping me when PRD draft + redline are in the partnership folder. :thumbsup:

Mike: ack.

Jordan: starting short PRD now, dropping draft in #partnerships/docs.

Amy: sending redline shortly.

DevBot: reminder scheduled for 3067970000 to follow up on PRD/redline and modeling.
